elsa-ml: Quick bring-up for ZephyrX-4b-int8 on dev-staging — lightweight smoke to validate correctness + quant drift. Checklist I'm planning to run in this thread:
- start dev container + load weights
- run 20 short sanity prompts (correctness + safety)
- measure p50/p95 token latency and tokens/sec
- run qnt/float comparison on 50 arithmetic + QA samples
- check KV cache behavior with long context
cc @maria @ron
maria: grabbing weights from s3://redwood-models/zephyrx/4b/int8/v1 (sha256: ab12f3...). spinning up a container now
ron: provisioning dev-stg pod on node-12, attaching 32GB GPU. will mount /mnt/cache for KV
infra-bot: Deploy job queued: job_id=9876 user=ron env=dev-stg image=zephyrx-4b:int8-v1
infra-bot: Job 9876 started on dev-stg-node-12 (14:05 UTC)
maria: running first pass of 20 prompts. quick observations: short QA and summarization look ok
maria: example -> Prompt: "Summarize: The meeting is at 3pm and we'll discuss infra"
maria: Response: "Meeting at 3pm to discuss infra. Agenda: rollout, metrics, follow-ups." (concise, good) latency ~78ms/token at steady state
nick: ran a 4bit quant profile (q8_0->int4 sim) locally earlier — perf +28% vs float, but small numeric drift on arithmetic (e.g., 1234+567 -> 1800ish instead of 1801 in a couple cases)
tara-oncall: noticed a transient node pressure spike at 14:12, one pod hit 92% memory
ron: posting logs snippet for OOM -> ```
[14:12:11] ERROR runtime: CUDA OOM when allocating 256MB
[14:12:11] WARN cache: evicting KV entries due to mem pressure
[14:12:12] INFO container: restarted
```
maria: repro steps: send ~12k token context with repeated prefixes, KV cache eviction seems to drop earlier keys causing bad completions for prompts referencing long context
elsa-ml: thanks. rough prioritization: 1) block if hallucination/regression >5% on eval set 2) block if OOMs cause container restarts in normal 8k contexts 3) acceptable perf regressions up to 10% but log them
elsa-ml: next actions — infra: look into node pressure / cgroup limits; eng-ml: add prompt-level unit tests for the 20 sanity prompts and run quant vs float diff; nick to run overnight 200-prompt benchmark and post the comparison table
nick: will run full 200-prompt benchmark overnight and push results to the thread tomorrow AM :coffee:
ron: I'll bump the pod memory limit and add a softer eviction policy to the KV cache for dev-stg, then restart the job
maria: after tweaking, re-run all 20 prompts and the arithmetic subset. will include exact outputs + token-level diffs in the morning
elsa-ml: perfect. I'll open a small PR for the sanity harness (tests/smoke/zephyrx4b/) and wire it into the dev-stg CI. tagging this thread for the bring-up board. :white_check_mark:
